stories.title: Punjab Congress forms panel to oversee induction of leaders from other parties
stories.summary: Ahead of next year's Assembly elections, Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh on Sunday formed a four-member committee to oversee and coordinate the induction of leaders from other parties. stories.title: CRPF withdraws anti-Naxal battalion from Chhattisgarh for Manipur duties

stories.title: FPIs pump ₹84,290 crore into equities in first fortnight of November
stories.summary: Foreign investors made a strong comeback to Indian equities in the first fortnight of November, pumping in ₹84,290 crore after two consecutive months of net outflows, amid a global AI sell-off, falling crude prices and attractive large-cap valuations. stories.title: Who owns your digital twin? The hidden risk of health data
stories.summary: For the average citizen, the appeal of digital health is enticing — the convenience of e-pharmacies, instant diagnostics, virtual consultations, and the motivation of fitness trackers. stories.title: Nashik: ₹70-Crore SCADA Project To Monitor Water Supply, Curb Leakages Ahead Of Kumbh
stories.summary: AI Nashik: In a major step towards strengthening the city's water management system, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) meters have been installed at five water treatment plants in Nashik. stories.title: Ganga turns crystal clear near Haridwar after 150 tonnes of waste removed ahead of 2027 Ardh Kumbh, video
stories.summary: If you have scrolled through social media lately, you might have come across a viral video of the Ganga in Haridwar looking almost unrecognizable, clear enough to spot stone tiles resting on the riverbed and small fish darting beneath the surface. For anyone used to seeing murky water and floating debris around busy pilgrimage spots, the clip offered a welcome surprise.

stories.title: Hyderabad comes together for Chhath Puja as lakhs offer prayers to setting sun
stories.summary: As the sun slowly dipped towards the horizon on Sunday evening, the banks of Hyderabad’s lakes and water bodies turned into vibrant centres of devotion. Women stood waist-deep in water, bamboo baskets laden with fruits and traditional offerings in their hands, waiting for the moment to offer prayers to the setting sun.

stories.summary: Anand Chaini Pune: Jambhulwadi Lake in Katraj witnessed a vibrant display of faith and devotion on Sunday evening as devotees gathered to celebrate Chhath Puja. Women dressed in colourful traditional sarees stood knee-deep in the water, holding bamboo baskets and plates filled with fruits, flowers and other offerings as they offered prayers to the setting Sun.

stories.title: Sabarimala sets target of 75 pilgrims a minute on holy steps
stories.summary: As many as 75 pilgrims are expected to climb the 18 holy steps to the Sabarimala shrine every minute under a new crowd management target set by the authorities for the annual pilgrimage season, which kicks off on Tuesday. stories.title: What Is Usha Arghaya? Dos And Dont's To Follow On The Fourth Day Of Chhath Mahaparv
stories.summary: Puja is a four-day festival marked by fasting, holy bathing, a disciplined lifestyle, purity of mind and body, and deep devotion. The fourth day of the sacred festival is dedicated to Usha Arghya, which marks the conclusion of the four-day celebrations. On the final day, devotees gather before dawn to offer Usha Arghya to the rising Sun.
